description: Satellite detected landslides / mudslides over Kibingo, Congonil, Kagana and Ghanga Villages, Rutsiro District, Western Province, Rwanda as of 7 May 2023 is a hazard data set listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT). UNOSAT code FL20230504RWA, GDACS Id: 1101977 This map illustrates satellite-detected landslides / mudslides around Kibingo, Congonil, Kagana and Ghanga Villages in Rutsiro District (Western Province, Rwanda) as observed/detected from a Sentinel-2 satellite imagery acquired on 07 May 2023 at 08:30 local time. Within the analysed area, about 2,5 km2 of landslides scars are observed. Coverage: Rwanda. The portal files it under the publisher United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT). Its tags are flooding, geodata. It offers 2 resource(s) in GEODATABASE, SHP. The portal shows 2025-08-26 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
